context.summary: Olivia began the year in Vancouver, organizing a New Year's beach cleanup with a team of volunteers. Despite freezing temperatures, they collected over 300 kilograms of plastic waste and shared hot cocoa afterward to celebrate their effort.
what: Leading a winter beach cleanup and community awareness event.

context.summary: In Nairobi, Olivia attended a youth climate leadership summit where she delivered a keynote on grassroots sustainability movements. She met representatives from African NGOs and discussed collaborative reforestation projects.
what: Speaking at a climate leadership summit and networking with NGOs.

context.summary: Olivia traveled to New Delhi to volunteer with a local waste management startup. She spent the week sorting recyclables and helping train workers in digital tracking methods for landfill reduction.
what: Assisting a startup in developing sustainable recycling practices.

context.summary: In Berlin, Olivia collaborated with university researchers to pilot a plastic-to-fuel conversion prototype. She co-authored a paper on how community-level technology adoption can reduce dependency on imported fuel sources.
what: Testing sustainable energy technology and co-writing a research paper.

context.summary: Back home in Seattle, Olivia hosted a workshop for high school students on everyday sustainability. She introduced practical tips for waste reduction and shared her experiences working abroad.
what: Teaching sustainability practices to students in a community workshop.

context.summary: In Oslo, Olivia met with an environmental NGO to plan a campaign focused on ocean microplastics. They developed an online pledge platform to encourage individuals to track their plastic use.

Olivia participated in a large-scale river cleanup in Bangkok, joining over 200 volunteers to remove debris from the Chao Phraya River. She documented the event for her social media channel to inspire others worldwide.
what: Coordinating and filming a major river cleanup operation.

context.summary: In Cape Town, Olivia reunited with fellow activists from the Nairobi summit to plant native trees around drought-affected areas. They celebrated reaching their goal of 1,000 saplings planted within three days.
what: Organizing a reforestation drive with international volunteers.

context.summary: Olivia spoke at a United Nations side event in Geneva about youth-led climate innovation. She emphasized equitable funding for local initiatives and highlighted success stories from her Berlin and Nairobi projects.
what: Delivering a policy-focused talk at a UN climate forum.

context.summary: To close the year, Olivia returned to Vancouver to produce a documentary short summarizing her global campaigns. She worked with local filmmakers and narrated reflections on collaboration, resilience, and hope for 2026.
what: Producing a documentary on her environmental advocacy journey.
